draft.emotion: appetizing and savory, thinking about a nice meal
notes: Usually singular and uncountable when referring to food in general (e.g., 'non mangio carne' — I don't eat meat).
In the sense of 'flesh', it is very common in the expression 'in carne e ossa' (in the flesh / in person).
